content.title: NUTRIENT DEFICIENCIES THAT HIDE BEHIND EVERYDAY {{SYMPTOMS}}
facts: **Iron** – Fatigue, pale skin, shortness of breath, and brittle nails.
**Vitamin D** – Bone and muscle aches, low mood, frequent colds, and thinning hair.
**Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, twitching eyelids, trouble sleeping, and irritability.
**Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands or feet, low energy, brain fog, and mood changes.
**Zinc** – Slow-healing cuts, frequent colds, loss of taste or smell, and hair shedding.
**Vitamin C** – Bleeding gums, easy bruising, slow-healing wounds, and joint pain.
**Calcium** – Muscle cramps, tingling fingers, brittle nails, and dental problems.
**Folate** – Fatigue, mouth sores, pale skin, and trouble concentrating.
**Vitamin A** – Dry eyes, poor night vision, rough skin, and frequent infections.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, vision changes, numbness, and weaker immunity.
**Omega-3** – Dry skin, joint stiffness, low mood, and dry, irritated eyes.
**Follow along** – for more everyday signs your body might be trying to send you.
content.caption:
None of these symptoms automatically mean you have a deficiency — fatigue, dry skin, or trouble sleeping can come from stress, sleep habits, or a dozen other things. Bodies are different, so think of this as a gentle nudge to pay attention, not a diagnosis, and always check in with a doctor before changing anything major.
